items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was on the date Charlie Haden and I together to do that CD we did

ctx.x: It was his idea? Did he put the two of you together?

Yes, he did. Of course he was on the date Charlie Haden and I together to do that CD we did. We had done the concert in Montréal and it seemed to work doing both spirituals and jazz. So he said, "Let's do that on a recording."
So, did you… This is really digressing but, have you had a close relationship with him as a producer? Did he bring new project ideas?
